# Endpoints and why each one is collected

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-endpoints-doc.mjs from src/endpoints.ts — do not edit by hand. -->

Every GET this tool can make is registered in `src/endpoints.ts`. The collector
(Mode A, and the same code compiled as the Mode B single binary) iterates this
registry only; anything not listed here cannot be requested.
`tests/collector-policy.test.ts` runs the collector against a fake API that
plants sensitive values and fails if any reach the output.

Every endpoint feeds at least one check; endpoints collected "just in case"
were removed in v0.2 (data minimization).

## Account level

| Endpoint | Why it's collected | Token permission (read) | Plan tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/accounts` | Enumerate accounts; everything else is scoped per account. | Account Settings: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/settings` | Account posture: enforce 2FA, abuse contact, API access settings. | Account Settings: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/members` | 2FA adoption and role concentration. Only role names + 2FA booleans are exported; no names or emails. | Account Settings: Read | any |
| `/user/tokens` | Token expiry/rotation posture (status, expiry, last-use only). | User API Tokens: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/tokens` | Account-owned token inventory (metadata only). | Account API Tokens: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/load_balancers/pools` | Pool health-check hygiene and failover posture. | Load Balancer Monitors and Pools: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/load_balancers/monitors` | Monitor configuration sanity (intervals, expected codes). | Load Balancer Monitors and Pools: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/rulesets` | Account-level custom/managed rulesets (Enterprise) — shared WAF across zones. | Account Rulesets: Read | enterprise |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/access/apps` | Access application inventory: policy-less apps and bypass decisions. | Access: Apps and Policies: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/access/identity_providers` | IdP posture: OTP-only setups are a finding. | Access: Identity Providers: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/challenges/widgets` | Turnstile inventory: widgets present, domains bound, mode. | Turnstile Widgets: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel` | Tunnel inventory: unsecured internal services exposed via public hostnames. | Cloudflare Tunnel: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/workers/scripts` | Worker script inventory: routes bound, plaintext binding names/types. | Workers Scripts: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/storage/kv/namespaces` | Data-at-rest inventory (count only). | Workers KV Storage: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/d1/database` | Data-at-rest inventory (count only). | D1: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets` | Data-at-rest inventory (count only). | Workers R2 Storage: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/ai-gateway/gateways` | AI Gateway inventory: rate limiting, authentication, DLP, guardrails, and log collection posture. | AI Gateway: Read | any |
| `/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations` | Tunnel public hostname inventory: cross-reference with Access apps to detect unprotected public routes. | Cloudflare Tunnel: Read | any |

## Zone level

| Endpoint | Why it's collected | Token permission (read) | Plan tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/zones` | Zone inventory: plan, status, paused — drives plan-tier applicability of all checks. | Zone: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/settings` | Core posture: SSL mode, min TLS, HSTS, always-use-HTTPS, security level, challenge passage, bot fight mode, DNSSEC. | Zone Settings: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/rulesets` | Ruleset inventory: which phases have deployed rulesets at all. | Zone Rulesets: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/rulesets/phases/{phase}/entrypoint` | Live rules per phase (custom WAF, managed WAF + overrides, rate limiting parameters, HTTP DDoS overrides, response header transforms). A 404 is recorded as 'absent' (nothing deployed), a 403 as 'unreadable'. | Phase-specific: Zone WAF: Read (firewall/ratelimit), HTTP DDoS Managed Ruleset: Read (ddos_l7), Transform Rules: Read, Cache Rules: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/bot_management` | Bot posture: Bot Fight Mode (Free), Super Bot Fight Mode actions (Pro/Business), JS detections, AI-crawler blocking. Allow-listed keys only. | Bot Management: Read (or Zone WAF: Read) | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules` | IP access rules: allowlist entries bypass every security product. Exported as mode/target only; IP values redacted, country/ASN kept. | Firewall Services: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/pagerules` | Legacy page rules that disable security, lower security level, or weaken SSL. Exported as action ids + enumerated values; URL targets dropped. | Page Rules: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records` | DNS hygiene: subdomain-takeover risk, missing CAA, MX posture, orphaned records. Content values are redacted by default. | DNS: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/ssl/certificate_packs` | Custom cert packs: expiry and coverage. | SSL and Certificates: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes` | What runs where: Workers routes vs zone traffic. | Workers Routes: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/rate_limits` | Legacy rate-limiting product still active — migration signal (old endpoint, not ratelimit phase). | Zone Rate Limiting: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/managed_headers` | Managed Transforms: whether 'Add security headers' and 'Remove X-Powered-By' are on. | Transform Rules: Read (or Zone Settings: Read) | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/leaked-credential-checks` | Leaked credentials detection enabled (flags requests using known-breached credential pairs). | Zone WAF: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/page_shield` | Client-side security (Page Shield) enablement: script/connection/cookie monitoring, malicious script detection. | Page Shield: Read | business-plus |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth/settings` | Authenticated Origin Pulls (mTLS) enablement: verifies requests come from Cloudflare network. | SSL and Certificates: Read | any |
| `/zones/{zone_id}/origin_tls_client_auth` | Authenticated Origin Pulls zone-level certificates: custom cert preferred over shared global cert. | SSL and Certificates: Read | any |

## Phases whose entrypoint rules are collected

`http_request_firewall_custom`, `http_request_firewall_managed`, `http_ratelimit`, `ddos_l7`, `http_request_cache_settings`, `http_response_headers_transform`

A `404` on a phase entrypoint is recorded as `phaseStatus: "absent"` (nothing
deployed — a readable fact); any other failure as `"unreadable"`. Rules are
exported with a sanitized `actionParameters` summary (executed managed ruleset,
override shape, skip scope, rate-limit parameters, header names) — see
`src/summarize.ts` and `docs/data-policy.md`.

## Also called

- `/user/tokens/verify` — token status only (`active`), never token material.

## What is deliberately NOT collected

- Any endpoint requiring write scope — the tool has no write code at all.
- Logs, Logpush, analytics, request samples — request data never leaves the account.
- Worker script contents, KV values, secret binding values, Access policy identity
  expressions, header values in transform rules, rate-limit counting expressions.
- Removed in v0.2 because no check consumed them: `/firewall/waf/overrides` (legacy WAF),
  `/ssl/verification`, zone `/load_balancers`, `/api_gateway/discovery`,
  `/api_gateway/configuration`, `/access/service_tokens`, and the
  `http_request_transform`, `http_request_dynamic_redirect`, `http_request_origin`,
  `http_request_redirect` phases. API Shield returns with real checks (see the
  evolution doc).
